lines.text: Ada paid nine thousand six hundred for the group. Now she is the debt collector.
Eleven days. Four reminders. Seven thousand two hundred unpaid.
What if nobody had to pay first?
Sutra turns the group into a coordinated decision.
Each person sees one exact share, one personal cap, and their own card.
Approval is permission, not a charge.
The last required yes locks the plan. Unknown results are reconciled before retry.
Start with a sentence, a link, an extension-imported cart, or a bill.
Then the agent gathers availability, distance, and private budgets.
Real venues re-rank live, with reasons the group can inspect.
Ask Sutra who is missing, and it answers from the group's real state.
But ask it to pay for you? Hard no. Your passkey is the boundary.
The same protocol ships as a NANDA Town payments plugin.
The bundled ledger credits the organiser. Prava mandates never do.
The labeled simulation proves scoped mandates without pooled funds.
Shopify discovery and extension imports work. POS stays merchant-operated.
Test orders prove merchant mapping. Production checkout needs an adapter.
Every outcome ends in a signed, hash-chained, rail-aware receipt.
No pooled wallet. Every handoff named. Nothing invented.
